_about: Context & Memory rows (settings audit, 2026-09-27). Settings has no open chat (user review, 2026-09-27): rows name what every chat does, and Squeeze now reads as a thing each chat's own menu does.

memory.retention.enabled.label: Remember things between chats
memory.retention.enabled.help: Off gives the assistant a clean slate every time.

memory.retention.gist-review-filter.label: Show
memory.retention.gist-review-filter.help: Which memories the list shows when you open it.

general.interaction.context-usage.label: Show a space meter in each chat
general.interaction.context-usage.help: A small meter in each chat shows how full its working space is.

memory.limits.manual-compact.label: Squeeze one chat now
memory.limits.manual-compact.help: Each chat's own menu has Squeeze now: it summarizes that chat's older part at once, for that chat only.

memory.limits.auto-compress.label: Squeeze old context automatically
memory.limits.auto-compress.help: Summarizes stale context so long chats don't stop.

memory.limits.compaction-mode.label: When automatic squeezing is off
memory.limits.compaction-mode.help: What happens once the space is full.

memory.limits.pressure-start-threshold.label: Start trimming at
memory.limits.pressure-start-threshold.help: A warning shows and gentle trimming begins.

memory.limits.pressure-aggressive-thresh.label: Trim hard at
memory.limits.pressure-aggressive-thresh.help: Past this point old context is squeezed firmly.

memory.limits.low-context-warning.label: Warn me when this much is left
memory.limits.low-context-warning.help: Time to wrap up, or to squeeze the chat.

memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.label: Largest working space
memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.help: In thousands of tokens; capped to what the model allows.
memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.placeholder: As large as the model allows

memory.limits.budget-buckets.label: How the space is split
memory.limits.budget-buckets.help: Shares for protected text, history, reply, tools and spare.

memory.limits.compaction-immune-pct.label: Never squeeze this share
memory.limits.compaction-immune-pct.help: The same share as Protected in How the space is split.

memory.limits.large-block-threshold.label: Trim chunks bigger than
memory.limits.large-block-threshold.help: Big chunks, in tokens, are trimmed first.

memory.limits.compaction-loop-limit.label: Squeezes in a row, at most
memory.limits.compaction-loop-limit.help: One pass is almost always enough.

memory.limits.local-llm-caps.label: Keep small helper models small
memory.limits.local-llm-caps.help: Helper and memory models never get the full history.

memory.notebook.auto-capture.label: Keep a working notebook
memory.notebook.auto-capture.help: Saves findings and dead ends during long tasks.

memory.notebook.resume-capsule.label: Add a short recap when work resumes
memory.notebook.resume-capsule.help: A brief 'where we were' note after a fresh start.

memory.notebook.capsule-budget-tokens.label: Recap size limit
memory.notebook.capsule-budget-tokens.help: Most tokens the recap may use.

memory.notebook.injection-budget-tokens.label: Notebook space per reply
memory.notebook.injection-budget-tokens.help: Most tokens of notebook text added to one reply.

memory.assembly.app-rules.label: Rules for every project
memory.assembly.app-rules.help: Standing instructions every run reads, everywhere.

memory.assembly.instruction-budget-mode.label: How instructions are packed

options.excerpt: Only the parts that fit the task

memory.assembly.instruction-budget-mode.help: Whether rules go in whole, within a size limit, or only the parts that fit the task.

memory.assembly.dry-method-guard.label: Reuse code before writing new code
memory.assembly.dry-method-guard.help: A nudge only; safety rules always apply.

memory.assembly.instruction-visibility.label: Show instructions with each run
memory.assembly.instruction-visibility.help: How much of the rules a run was given you see next to it.

memory.assembly.injected-context-breakdo.label: List what was packed into each run
memory.assembly.injected-context-breakdo.help: Every file and note given to a run, with its size.

memory.assembly.compiled-prompt-preview.label: Let me preview the full prompt
memory.assembly.compiled-prompt-preview.help: Lets you read the whole prompt before it is sent.

memory.assembly.integrity-tracking.label: Record where each instruction came from
memory.assembly.integrity-tracking.help: Each instruction keeps a note of the file it came from.

memory.assembly.memory-capsule-budget.label: Memory space per reply
memory.assembly.memory-capsule-budget.help: Most tokens of memory added before each reply.

memory.retention.retrieval-mode.label: Bring memories in
memory.retention.retrieval-mode.help: Automatically fits most chats. Only when I ask keeps replies free of memories unless you say so.

memory.retention.rehydration.label: When a chat starts, reload what it knew
memory.retention.rehydration.help: What a new chat loads from the last one.

memory.retention.retrieval-balance.label: Exact words or meaning
memory.retention.retrieval-balance.help: 0 leans on exact words, 100 on meaning.

memory.retention.half-life-by-kind.label: Fade time for each kind of note
memory.retention.half-life-by-kind.help: Days until an unused note of that kind fades.
memory.retention.half-life-by-kind.editorHelp: What a chat is working on, something stopping progress, and a rule the work must follow: an unused note of that kind fades after this many days.

keys.CurrentThread: What a chat is working on

memory.retention.done-decay-multiplier.label: Notes about finished work fade faster
memory.retention.done-decay-multiplier.help: 50% means notes about finished work last half as long.

memory.retention.auto-save-unverified.label: Keep unconfirmed notes
memory.retention.auto-save-unverified.help: Notes the assistant proposes wait for someone to check them. Off drops them when the chat ends.

memory.retention.pinned-unverified-injec.label: Use pinned notes even if unconfirmed
memory.retention.pinned-unverified-injec.help: Off leaves a pinned note out of replies until someone confirms it.

memory.retention.verify-without-evidence.label: Let me confirm notes myself
memory.retention.verify-without-evidence.help: Off keeps the automatic re-check, the safer choice.

memory.retention.subagent-access.label: Helper agents can read memories
memory.retention.subagent-access.help: Off keeps helpers free of your history.

options.meta_only: Only what ran and how it ended
